meta.name: ablation-execution
meta.description: Remove components one by one from a system, record the response/impact of each removal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 逐一移除系统组件并记录每次影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过消融实验定位系统关键组件。
copy.tagline_en: Remove components one by one and record each impact
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify critical components via ablation experiments.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude会逐个移除系统中的组件，并记录每次移除后的响应或影响。
howto.when: 当你要求对系统进行消融分析，即逐一移除组件并观察变化时触发。

say.text: 对我的应用程序逐组件移除，记录每次变化。
say.note: Claude将依次移除组件并报告效果。

say.text: 对这个系统做消融实验，记录每个部件移除后的影响。
say.note: Claude会按顺序移除并记录结果。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will remove components from a system one by one and record the response or impact of each removal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to perform ablation analysis on a system, i.e., remove components one by one and observe changes.

say_en.text: Remove components from my app one by one and record each change.
say_en.note: Claude will remove components sequentially and report effects.

say_en.text: Run ablation on this system, recording impact after each removal.
say_en.note: Claude will systematically remove and log results.
